description:
Send an enquiry to the Voix and LogicBomb Media team through the contact form on their website.

Use this when someone wants to start a project, request a quote, book a demo, ask about pricing or timelines, discuss a partnership, or otherwise reach a human at Voix or LogicBomb Media.

The submission goes straight to the team's notifications and a person replies by email, normally within two business days. There is no other tool here — nothing reads data back, so this is the only thing this server does.

Call it only with details the person actually gave you: their real name, a reply-to address they confirmed, and their own description of what they need. Do not invent contact details, do not submit on a hunch, and tell the person you are sending the message before you send it. Each submission reaches a real human's inbox, so send one per enquiry rather than retrying a call that already succeeded.

budget.description: Indicative budget, only if the person has actually shared one. Never estimate this on their behalf.

company.description: Company or organisation they are enquiring on behalf of, if they mentioned one.

email.description: Email address to reply to. Must be one the person gave you — the answer goes here, so a guessed address means they never hear back.

message.description: What the enquiry is about, in the person's own words: what they are building, what they need from us, and any deadline they are working to.

name.description: Full name of the person making the enquiry.

phone.description: Phone number, if they would rather be called than emailed.

scope.description: The kind of work the enquiry is about. Pick the closest match only if it is clear from what they told you.

name: submit_contact_form

reference.description: Short reference for this submission. Give it to the person so they can quote it if they follow up.

replyBy.description: Plain-English description of when to expect a reply.

submitted.description: True when the enquiry reached the team.

title: Contact the Voix team
